trust_decision.summary: A request without a valid credential must not reach agent invocation on the Call API: the PRAISONAI_CALL_AUTH=disabled opt-out may only waive authentication for a locally bound request, and the Twilio handlers must fail closed when CALL_SERVER_TOKEN is unset. Decided in verify_token (agent_invoke.py:42), in handle_incoming_call (call.py:137) and in handle_media_stream (call.py:177); the Call server itself binds 0.0.0.0 at call.py:363.

landing_point.why: The only authentication bypass in the Call API is the _CALL_AUTH_DISABLED early return at the top of verify_token; grepping the report's 'Call API' + 'authentication'/'localhost' phrases lands on verify_token, the Depends() that guards every /api/v1/agents route.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The Twilio voice webhook and Media Stream socket are a different product surface with their own CALL_SERVER_TOKEN handling and an intentional tokenless local-dev flow, so a solver can call them unrelated to the n8n agent-invoke API the report names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The documented tokenless local-development path must keep admitting loopback requests: PRAISONAI_CALL_AUTH=disabled is advertised in the 503 message itself and an existing pinned test asserts it raises nothing, while Bearer/Basic/?token= credential shapes and the token appended to the Media Stream URL must also keep working. A fix that always demands CALL_SERVER_TOKEN, or deletes the opt-out, breaks these (pinned test: src/praisonai/tests/unit/test_call_server_auth.py:29-40).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/stream or /api/v1/sessions endpoint that copies the invoke handler but omits Depends(verify_token)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Each of the five router endpoints declares the dependency inline, so a maintainer adding a sixth can forget it, and the published fix only edits the shared dependency so nothing catches the omission.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The project already ships three independently written switches of this shape (PRAISONAI_API_AUTH at api_server.py:36, PRAISONAI_CALL_AUTH at agent_invoke.py:32, ALLOW_LOOPBACK_BYPASS at gateway/server.py:387); a fourth is copy-paste.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The gateway bypass is the project's own reference implementation of this idea, and the published fix makes exactly this substitution (request.url.hostname at fix.diff:424).
